description: Complete a database migration when the user confirms the migration is ready to be applied to the main branch.

databaseName.description: Optional name of the database to apply the migration to; when omitted, the database recorded when the migration was prepared is used.

migrationId.description: ID of the prepared migration session returned by prepare_database_migration.

projectId.description: ID of the Neon project the migration was prepared for; must match the prepared migration's project.

name: complete_database_migration
